If we attempted to land on the planet's surface, our ship would immediately implode.''"<br />"''Subtram it is, then.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Rigosso/Legends|Rigosso]]|<ref name="Bounty (episode)">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Quarzite''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] composed of [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Cave/Legends|caves]] and with a surface that was strained by strong [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] pressure, with the ability to crush [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and flatten beings. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was ruled by the tyrannical [[Belugan/Legends|Belugan]] [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]], who was involved in a battle with the natives on the planet, the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]].

==Description==
[[File:QuarziteCaves-Bounty.png|thumb|left|220px|The caves of Quarzite.]]

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was purple in color, and its interior was dotted with crystalline caverns of equalized pressure, allowing for life to be present on the planet.

An immense [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] shaft allowed access to these interior habitable regions from space, and [[Subtram/Legends|Subtram]] was the primary method of planetary travel.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the planet maintained its neutrality, but was not without its own problems. It was ruled by the harsh [[Belugan/Legends|Belugan]] dictator [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]]. His rule was constantly threatened by the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]], who were led by [[Krismo Sodi/Legends|Krismo Sodi]].
